title: What share of new cars sold in Norway are fully electric?
subtitle: A host and an oil-country skeptic: drag a pie slice to guess Norway's share of fully electric new cars, then see how fast it got there.
notes: Uses 2025 (95.4% fully electric). Pie has a 2010 stage (0.3%) so the picture matches the line. Wording almost no purchase tax or VAT (VAT applies above NOK 500k since 2023). World 2025 16.5% from IEA via OWID. World shown as a hand-built mini pie (shape + sector). Slice labels stay engine-small: label_size shrinks the pie.
